meta.note: Each snapshot is a dated end-of-day record. Add a new entry to refresh; the code picks the latest as_of by default. Values were transcribed from the cited pages, not downloaded by API, so re-check against NSE before relying on them.
meta.volatility_note: india_vix is NSE's 30-day implied-volatility index (percent). It is used as a flat proxy for the volatility of every strike. It is NOT the implied volatility of any individual option.
